info.title: EMAC ERP & Customer Authentication API
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for the EMAC platform including Customer Authentication, OTP verification, Password Management, Social Login, and User Profiles.

200.description: Active Terms and Conditions retrieved successfully

404.description: Terms and conditions document not found

address.description: Primary address line (stored in user_addresses table)

message.example: Registration successful. Please verify your account using the OTP sent to your registered contact.
The email field must be a valid email address.

200.description: Login successful with Bearer access token

post.summary: Verify OTP (Registration issues access_token and logs user in directly)

200.description: OTP verified successfully. If purpose is registration, returns access_token and user object.

message.example: Account verified successfully. You are now logged in.

200.description: If an account exists, OTP has been sent

post.summary: Request OTP for authenticated password change
Change password using short-lived change token (renews user access_token)

200.description: Password changed successfully with renewed access_token

message.example: Password changed successfully. Your session has been renewed.

patch.summary: Update or complete profile (supports JSON or multipart form-data with image upload)

image.description: Profile picture / image (JPEG, PNG, JPG, WEBP, max 5MB)

avatar.description: Profile picture alias (JPEG, PNG, JPG, WEBP, max 5MB)

get.description: Get a paginated list of service requests submitted by the authenticated customer (or all requests if admin/staff). Supports filtering by category_id, subcategory_id, status, priority, and pagination.

200.description: List of service requests retrieved successfully

post.summary: Submit a new customer service request
post.description: Allows authenticated customers to submit a service request with category ID, optional subcategory ID, description, property details, location address ID, schedule preferences, priority, optional notes, photographs (jpg/png/webp max 10MB), and videos (mp4/mov/avi max 50MB).

category_id.description: ID of the selected service category (from /api/v1/categories/catalog)

description.description: Detailed written description of the issue
description.example: Central AC is making a loud rattling noise and not blowing cold air.

property_information.example: 2-storey residential villa, Unit 4B, rooftop AC compressor access via exterior ladder.

user_address_id.description: ID of existing user address record from user_addresses table

is_emergency.description: Set true if this is an urgent/emergency repair request (defaults to false)

priority.description: Priority of service: normal (default) or emergency

additional_notes.example: Gate code is 4321. Please call 15 minutes before arrival.

photographs[].description: Up to 10 image files (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, max 10MB each)

videos[].description: Up to 3 video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, max 50MB each)

description.example: Central AC is making a loud rattling noise.

get.summary: Get details of a specific service request
Get details of a price quote
get.description: Allows customer to view itemized pricing, labor, materials, trip charges, discounts, taxes, and terms for an issued quote.

post.description: Customer can approve, decline, or ask a question regarding an issued price quote.

customer_notes.example: Can we schedule this for Friday morning?

get.summary: Get complete service catalog (categories with subcategories & prices)
get.description: Retrieves all active categories hierarchically along with subcategories and regional service prices. Pass region_id or region (ID, slug, code e.g. "grand-cayman", "GCM", 1) to filter pricing for a specific territory. Pass only_with_prices=1 to only return categories with pricing in that region.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Filter pricing to a specific region ID (e.g. 1 for Grand Cayman, 2 for Florida)

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Filter by region ID, slug, code, or name (e.g. "grand-cayman", "GCM", "florida", 1)

parameters.name: only_with_prices
parameters.description: Pass 1 to only return items that have configured prices in the selected region

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query for category/subcategory name or description

message.example: Categories with subcategories and pricing retrieved successfully.

get.summary: List categories (with optional subcategories and pricing)
get.description: Returns categories list. Pass with_subcategories=1 or with_prices=1 to load subcategories and pricing. Pass region_id or region to filter pricing.
Returns subcategories with category details and regional pricing. Filter by category_id, region_id, or region.

Retrieves all operational service regions (e.g. Grand Cayman, Florida, Jamaica) with their currency, short codes, and active status. Pass all=1 or per_page=all to get the full list for dropdown selectors.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Pass 1 or true to return all regions without pagination

get.summary: Get single region details with service prices
get.description: Retrieves details for a specific region by its ID along with regional pricing matrix.

get.summary: List all quotes for authenticated customer
get.description: Retrieves all quotes issued to the currently authenticated customer without needing quote ID. Can be filtered by status or service_request_id.

parameters.name: service_request_id
parameters.description: Filter by specific Service Request ID

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by quote status: pending, approved, declined, ask_for_question

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Pass 1 to get all without pagination

get.summary: Get quote by Service Request ID
get.description: Retrieves the latest quote for a specific service request using the service_request_id. Customer does not need the quote ID.

404.description: No quote found for this service request

post.summary: Respond to a quote by Service Request ID
post.description: Customer can approve, decline, or ask questions on a quote directly using the service request ID.

customer_notes.example: Approved, please proceed with the service.

404.description: No quote found for this service request

bearerAuth.description: Enter your Bearer token in the format: Bearer <token>
